views.definition:
SELECT d.slug AS dataset,
    m.model_key,
    m.official_name,
    m.is_selected,
    max(mt.metric_value) FILTER (WHERE ((mt.metric_name = 'accuracy'::text) AND (mt.scope = 'overall'::text))) AS accuracy,
    max(mt.metric_value) FILTER (WHERE ((mt.metric_name = 'balanced_accuracy'::text) AND (mt.scope = 'overall'::text))) AS balanced_accuracy,
    max(mt.metric_value) FILTER (WHERE ((mt.metric_name = ANY (ARRAY['precision'::text, 'macro_precision'::text])) AND (mt.scope = 'overall'::text))) AS "precision",
    max(mt.metric_value) FILTER (WHERE ((mt.metric_name = ANY (ARRAY['recall'::text, 'macro_recall'::text])) AND (mt.scope = 'overall'::text))) AS recall,
    max(mt.metric_value) FILTER (WHERE ((mt.metric_name = 'macro_f1'::text) AND (mt.scope = 'overall'::text))) AS macro_f1,
    max(mt.metric_value) FILTER (WHERE ((mt.metric_name = 'pr_auc'::text) AND (mt.scope = 'overall'::text))) AS pr_auc,
    max(mt.metric_value) FILTER (WHERE ((mt.metric_name = 'roc_auc'::text) AND (mt.scope = 'overall'::text))) AS roc_auc,
    max(mt.metric_value) FILTER (WHERE ((mt.metric_name = 'brier'::text) AND (mt.scope = 'overall'::text))) AS brier,
    max(mt.metric_value) FILTER (WHERE ((mt.metric_name = 'nll'::text) AND (mt.scope = 'overall'::text))) AS nll,
    max(mt.metric_value) FILTER (WHERE ((mt.metric_name = 'ece'::text) AND (mt.scope = 'overall'::text))) AS ece
   FROM (((ml.model m
     JOIN catalog.dataset d ON ((d.dataset_id = m.dataset_id)))
     JOIN ml.run r ON (((r.model_id = m.model_id) AND (r.status = 'completed'::text))))
     LEFT JOIN ml.metric mt ON ((mt.run_id = r.run_id)))
  GROUP BY d.slug, m.model_key, m.official_name, m.is_selected;

SELECT cr.source_record_id,
    rp.risk_probability,
    rp.risk_band,
    rp.uncertainty,
    rp.escalation_required,
    p.plan_id,
    p.status AS plan_status,
    count(DISTINCT a.action_id) AS action_count,
    COALESCE(sum(a.workload_minutes), (0)::bigint) AS workload_minutes,
    COALESCE(max(rv.status), 'PENDING_EXPERT_LABELS'::text) AS review_status
   FROM ((((recommendation.plan p
     JOIN recommendation.risk_profile rp ON ((rp.risk_profile_id = p.risk_profile_id)))
     JOIN catalog.record cr ON ((cr.record_pk = rp.record_pk)))
     LEFT JOIN recommendation.action a ON ((a.plan_id = p.plan_id)))
     LEFT JOIN recommendation.review rv ON ((rv.plan_id = p.plan_id)))
  GROUP BY cr.source_record_id, rp.risk_probability, rp.risk_band, rp.uncertainty, rp.escalation_required, p.plan_id, p.status;
